messages:
annar (PM): quick sync — need to pick a prioritization approach for Q2 pricing work: reserved capacity + tiers + rate limits. customers pushing for reserved SLAs. do we use RICE or simple impact/effort for sequencing?
kevin (Eng): i'd favor impact/effort for rapid sequencing, but RICE helps justify infra spend to finance.
deepa (Growth): from a go-to-market view, we need clear launch criteria per tier (SLA, headroom, onboarding flow). prioritizing high-touch reserved for a few customers first makes sense.
jess (Sales): +1. Acme & Quokka are asking for 99.9% reserved throughput and burst credits. if we don't ship a reserved pilot soon we risk losing both deals.
liam (Finance): we need a numbers-based tie-break. show me expected ARR uplift vs incremental infra cost. RICE lets us surface Confidence which matters here.
annar (PM): proposing a hybrid: use RICE for top-level bucket prioritization (reserved pilot vs broad tiering) then impact/effort to sequence engineering tickets inside the chosen bucket. quick strawman below.
kevin (Eng): show the strawman pls.
annar (PM): quick RICE examples for two options (ballpark):
```
Option A — Reserved pilot (small set of enterprise customers)
Reach = 20 customers in Q2 (R=20)
Impact = 0.6 (mid-high uplift per customer)
Confidence = 0.6
Effort = 3 PMs * 2 months = 6 PM-months -> scaled to 6
RICE = (20 * 0.6 * 0.6) / 6 = 1.2

Option B — Tiered PAYG + rate-limits + burst credits (self-serve)
Reach = 2k customers in Q2 (R=2000)
Impact = 0.15
Confidence = 0.7
Effort = 4 PM-months -> 4
RICE = (2000 * 0.15 * 0.7) / 4 = 52.5
```
kevin (Eng): interesting — Option B wins by RICE because of reach, despite lower per-customer impact. but operationally Option A has higher infra/sla complexity (stateful capacity, SLA guarantees).
deepa (Growth): Option B helps unlock PLG expansion and nets more usage signals for Optimize. Option A is defensible only if we can convert pilot customers to committed contracts quickly.
jess (Sales): conversion estimate for pilots is ~40% ARR conversion in 6 months for these accounts. that multiplies Option A downstream value.
liam (Finance): can we fold conversion into RICE's Impact? currently "Impact" was per-quarter uplift, not LTV. mixing signals will confuse the model. suggestion: use RICE for short-term Q2 prioritization, and then a separate ROI model including conversion and infra opex for FY.
annar (PM): agreed. proposal for sequencing:
- Phase 1 (MVP 6 weeks): self-serve tiers + soft rate-limits + burst credits (low infra risk)
- Phase 2 (Parallel 8–12 weeks): reserved pilot infra work (capacity pools, SLA surface, billing commits) with 1–2 anchor customers
- Phase 3 (post-pilot): expand reserved offering + formalized on-ramps, docs, console UX
kevin (Eng): engineering caveat — we need API contract and rollout flags so Phase 2 can fallback to Phase 1 models if capacity issues. implement canary + autoscaler knobs.
annan (PM): small correction: annar, lol.
ops-bot (bot): deploy scheduled: feature/soft-rate-limits -> staging at 2029-03-12T15:30Z (simulated)
kevin (Eng): also adding metric targets for launch: p99 latency < 250ms for standard tier under 95th percentile load, reserved pilot capacity sustain at 80% load without degradation, billing accuracy <0.5% error.
deepa (Growth): launch checklist for tiers: docs, quickstart, pricing page copy, onboarding email, trial credit flow. needs GA copy signoff.
jess (Sales): I'll coordinate pilot NDAs and collect SLA contract needs. can we make pilot pricing non-binding but with conversion incentives?
liam (Finance): pilot discount OK if we model it as acquisition cost. keep explicit terms: minimum commitment window, conversion clause.
annar (PM): next steps: i'll spin up a short PRD with the RICE calc and the Phase plan, include the launch criteria above. @kevin please add engineering risk items and estimation. @jess gather pilot legal asks. we'll reconvene Fri 10am PT to decide final prioritization. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
kevin (Eng): will add risk register.
deepa (Growth): will draft marketing launch bullets.
jess (Sales): collecting pilot commitment language now.
liam (Finance): will prepare simple ROI sensitivity table ahead of Fri.
ops-bot (bot): meeting created: #product-pricing-q2 2029-03-15 10:00 PT
annar (PM): thanks all — trying to keep scope tight so we can land something before next earnings cycle.
kevin (Eng): noted. short, staged wins > big monolith.
